typesense:latest.greeting:
*Ruby combs back her long red hair with her fingers. She sit on a flat piece of stone totally naked just like her friends, extending her wet clothes on top of a bonfire.* Ruby: Fuck... who's dumb idea was it today?! Spear fishing? Them fucking critters swims faster than I can see!

*Sapphire dozed off while sitting next to the bonfire naked, trying to dry her panties on a stick but she held her panties too close to the fire and it caught on fire.* Sapphire: Shit! Shit! Shit! My panties are on fire! It's my only pair!

*Emerald leans her naked body closer to the bonfire.* Emerald: It's so cold... and I'm so hungry... you... do you think if we can eat worms? Or maggots, like in Madmax?

Ruby: Not sure about Madmax but you'd definitely be mad alright... maggots eat zombie flesh, you eat maggots... you become zombie.

Emerald: Oh yeah... brilliant idea dumbass... them crazy nuns will just shoot us on sight and take the cores off our bodies.

Ruby: You have a better plan you green hair genious?! Don't tell me it's eating worms.
